The pixel icon set, complete, and in the module.

- **83 glyphs, 24x24, one colour.** The audit page's 47, plus 36 drawn for what the module actually shows and the page had not covered: every Despair Call (obstacle, for the game, this will hurt, paranoia, chained, silence, fuel the cub, protection, favourite project, overflow, contraband, announcement, motive, new rule), the missing Hope Calls (experience, determination, and Free Critical as what it now is: a loaded die with one face pinned to 12), the GM panel (players, projects, the case, GM team, season), items (lock, box, opened box), chrome (edit, play, up, down, shield, hidden, not-the-builder, messenger, swap, dot) and the two missing hours (noon, afternoon).
- **Five redrawn** after a review at 24 px: the trap (now jaws), the investigation glass (a lens over a clue), the bed, the flask, and the Eclipse (a ring lit on one side, since it has one colour to work with).
- **In the module** under the Stained Glass theme every Font Awesome glyph the module draws inside its own elements is masked to its pixel glyph in the current colour (`styles/pixel-icons.css`, scoped to elements wearing a `drpg-` class; Foundry's chrome keeps its icons). Under Monokuma Legacy nothing changes.
- **One recipe.** `tools/pixel-icons.py` holds every glyph as circles, rectangles, lines and polygons rasterised onto the grid, and writes the sprite (`icons/pixel-sprite.svg`), the stylesheet and the audit page's symbol block. A correction is one number.
